status: Qualified component; whole modern inference and vLLM parity objective remains active

implementation.json: New bounded owned immutable JSON reader; rejects duplicate decoded keys, invalid UTF-8/surrogates, NUL strings, malformed syntax/trailing input and resource limits. Retains numeric lexemes without floating conversion.
implementation.architecture: Architecture-owned validation of DeepSeek V4.1 main expert dimensions, active count, EXL3 3-bit MUL1 and every main layer bit width. MTP metadata retained but main catalog excludes MTP.
implementation.model: bn_model_load_trellis_config parses and owns config, validates profile, and atomically binds model-owned catalog against borrowed native index. Caller buffer can be discarded after return. Backend resources release before catalog/config.
implementation.scope: Expert storage only. Legacy BnConfig/weights and executor admission are not populated; full native topology and generation remain pending. All other config fields remain in the owned document for future topology validation.

json_differential.reference: Python standard json with duplicate, UTF-8, NUL/surrogate and non-JSON constant rejection; numbers remain syntax-only (overflow exponents allowed)

validation.atomic_errors: Wrong schema/types/counts/quant profile, mixed main layer bit widths, config/source shape mismatch, duplicate load, missing fields, invalid JSON and late marker failure covered under ASAN/UBSAN.
validation.ownership: Synthetic test discards input and reads retained nested numeric/string fields; configured model backend teardown sees live catalog/config. Actual probe unmaps config immediately after load.

limitations: No full native topology, router, forward pass or generation admission.
Actual FFN inputs remain deterministic fixtures, not full-model hidden states.
Compressed GPU payload peak excludes context/library, request tensors/workspace, and host catalog/cache/staging.
Process RSS is diagnostic and includes index/runtime metadata; OS storage coldness was not controlled.
WASM script source list gained JSON dependency but WASM and NEON were not validated in this step.
No prefill/decode performance or vLLM parity claim.
